findings.subject: PR cannot be applied alone to stable v1.8.0
findings.evidence: Actual go run against /tmp/zl-sdk01-proposal-v1 failed: internaljson.UnmarshalUseNumber undefined. Stable internal/json lacks helper.
findings.required: Include reviewed minimal helper preserving stable max-depth and case-sensitive field admission. Record additional local diff and provenance.

findings.subject: MakeID float64 permits invalid IDs
findings.evidence: Independent run after review-only helper: float64 1.5 -> numeric 1 without error; NaN ->0; +Inf and +2^63 ->9223372036854775807 on this Go/toolchain.
findings.required: Reject NaN/Inf/fractional and values outside [-2^63,+2^63) before cast; accept representable valid integers. Already rounded caller float64 cannot be recovered.

findings.subject: Cancellation lookup can target a reused ID
findings.evidence: Source mcp/transport.go canceller.Preempt launches go c.conn.Cancel(id). Connection.Cancel resolves incomingByID inside the delayed goroutine. If original request completes and new invocation reuses ID before scheduling, notification cancels new invocation.
findings.required: Perform cancellation lookup synchronously or bind exact invocation before scheduling; add deterministic old-completion/new-ID-reuse adversarial test. Do not claim source-only inspection as runtime ID04 PASS.

findings.subject: Invalid numeric ID HTTP framing violates specified null-ID protocol error
findings.evidence: streamable.go handlePOST readBatch error branch calls http.Error malformed payload HTTP400, yielding plaintext rather than JSON-RPC envelope with id:null.
findings.required: Narrow SDK framing correction for invalid ID decode rejection with explicit error code/HTTP fixtures; equivalent STDIO invalid-ID framing also requires executable test.

findings.subject: Unbounded json.Number input length before big.Rat
findings.evidence: PR integerID applies no lexical length cap. Decimal digits can be long while bounded magnitude, e.g. 1 followed by arbitrarily many .0 digits, then big.Rat parses the entire input.
findings.required: Explicit 1024-byte numeric literal admission limit before numeric conversion/big.Rat; fix exponent budget and prove length/exponent negative checks have bounded CPU/memory.

findings.subject: Public json.Number malformed lexical forms
findings.evidence: Independent MakeID(json.Number(+1)) and MakeID(json.Number(01)) accepted despite invalid JSON-number spelling. Wire JSON parser rejects these, so no demonstrated remote wire regression.
findings.required: Prefer strict JSON numeric grammar in public MakeID, or explicitly scope/explain public caller representation contract and tests.

positive_evidence: Exact json.Number 9007199254740993.0 and -9223372036854775808.0 produced exact signed int64 values in independent codec run.
